title: Fulfillment Method
description: A fulfillment method (delivery or pickup) with a destination and options.

destination.description: The destination for fulfillment. For delivery: customer address. For pickup: food establishment location.

requested_fulfillment_time.description: Platform-requested fulfillment time as an RFC 3339 timestamp. When omitted, the business MUST interpret the request as ASAP fulfillment. When present, the business SHOULD return the nearest available fulfillment option matching the requested time. If the requested time is unavailable, the business SHOULD return a recoverable error with available alternatives in the fulfillment options array.

selected_option_id.description: Identifier of the selected fulfillment option.

notes.description: Optional input from the buyer for the fulfillment method. Common examples include delivery instructions.

destination.description: Platform-authored delivery address for this method.
Business-authored location able to fulfill this method. Response-only.
